<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <mxGraphModel adaptiveColors="auto" page="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="source" value="资料与种子题
保存来源版本" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#F3EEFF;strokeColor=#B9A6F0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="30" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="candidate" value="生成候选
问题、参考与证据" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="270" y="30" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="review" value="审核通过？" style="rhombus;fillColor=#FFF6E0;strokeColor=#E8C36A;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="510" y="15" width="180" height="90" /></mxCell><mxCell id="reject" value="暂不入库
保留拒绝原因" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#EBA3A3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="520" y="175" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="dedup" value="按题意去重
family + intent" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="270" y="175" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="split" value="按题族固定划分
同族不跨集合" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="175" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="dev" value="开发集
调试和校准" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#E7F6EC;strokeColor=#8BCB9F;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="320" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="hold" value="留出集
最后比较" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#E7F6EC;strokeColor=#8BCB9F;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="270" y="320" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-0" source="source" target="candidate" value="依据资料" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-1" source="candidate" target="review" value="核对" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-2" source="review" target="reject" value="否" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-3" source="review" target="dedup" value="是" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-4" source="dedup" target="split" value="去重后" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-5" source="split" target="dev" value="开发题族" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-6" source="split" target="hold" value="留出题族" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.7;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel>
